items.actClause: AN ACT to authorize the Hendrick Hudson central school district to establish an energy system tax stabilization reserve fund as the result of the closure of the Indian Point nuclear power plant
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5476

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to authorize the Hendrick Hudson central
school district to establish an energy system tax stabilization
reserve fund as the result of the closure of the Indian Point nuclear
power plant

 PURPOSE :

This bill will authorize the Hendrick Hudson central school district
to establish an energy system tax stabilization reserve fund

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section one establishes legislative findings.

Section two establishes definitions.

Section three authorizes the Hendrick Hudson central school district
to establish an energy system tax stabilization reserve fund to lesson
or prevent increase in the school district's real property tax levy
resulting from decreases in revenue due to the closure of the Indian
Point nuclear power plant. Establishment of such fund must be approved
by a majority vote of the voters present and voting on a separate
ballot proposition either at a special district meeting or at the
annual district meeting and election.

Section four establishes the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

On January 9, 2017, Governor Cuomo and Entergy announced the closing
of the Indian Point nuclear power plant by 2020 and 2021. The Indian
Point nuclear power plant in Westchester County has been a significant
contributor to the local economy for decades. Payments In Lieu of
Taxes (PILOT) to the Hendrick Hudson School District comprise a
significant amount of the school district's budget. The most recent
PILOT agreement for Entergy, the company that owns the Indian Point
facility, provides 30.6% of the revenue for the Hendrick Hudson school
budget. This PILOT agreement extends to 2024-25 and it is set to
provide increased PILOT payments to the school district until the
2020-2021 school year when they are set to rapidly decline.

This legislation will enable the Hendrick Hudson School District to
use the tax stabilization reserve fund to set aside revenue from the
Entergy PILOT agreements while remaining in compliance with state law
regarding reserve fund balances. Funds held in the tax stabilization
reserve fund will offset future revenue losses due to the impending
closure of Indian Point nuclear power plant.

There is legal precedent in the state for the use of tax stabilization
reserve funds to assist school districts manage increased PILOT
revenue and use it in future school budgets. Similar legislation was
enacted in 2001 (Ch. 202 L 2001) to create a temporary nuclear
facility tax stabilization fund for the Hendrick Hudson School
district that assisted with the management of increased PILOT
payments, and enable those funds to be used to stabilize future school
budgets.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New Bill

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None
 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Authorizes the Hendrick Hudson central school district to establish an energy system tax stabilization reserve fund to lessen or prevent increases in school district real property tax levies resulting from the decrease in revenue to such school district due to the closure of the Indian Point nuclear power plant.
title: Authorizes the Hendrick Hudson central school district to establish an energy system tax stabilization reserve fund
